saved_evidence.canonical_recorded_title: 2003 Library General Obligation Bond Project Scopes

text_excerpts.1:
LIBRARY BONDS
Purchase library materials such as books, periodicals,
audio visual materials, electronic resources and other
needed materials to meet customer demand for new
information, replace outdated materials, and provide
educational and informational materials for all libraries.
Library Materials
$2,000,000
Purchase and install updated automation equipment to
maintain network services, automated systems and
other equipment used to provide customers with access
to new information, library catalogs, web based services
and other electronic services.
Library Automation
$500,000
Renovate and repair the Special Collections Library
building to ensure that the facility is preserved and that
ongoing Library services can be delivered effectively.
Purchase historically appropriate furnishings and
equipment.
Special Collection Library:
Renovation / Historic
Preservation
$400,000
Design and construct improvements, purchase related
equipment and furnishings to correct critical deficiencies
in City library facilities and to provide service to growing
numbers of library users.  Request will reduce long term
maintenance cost
Library Building Improvement
$100,000
Design and construct ADA compliant parking spaces,
and provide equipment and materials for the Taylor
Ranch Library's children's room and video collection.
District 5, Taylor Ranch Library
$50,000
As provided in the City's "Art in Municipal Places"
ordinance, one percent of each bond purpose shall be
provided for Public Art.
1% for Public Art
$31,000
Total
$3,081,000
